dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0640 is part of the ORCA (日医標準レセプトソフト) system developed by NaCl for JMA.
evidence: ASSIGN RECE62PARA / RECE64PARA (file assignment style typical of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL)
no EXEC CICS, no EXEC SQL, no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - specifically inpatient (入院) diagnosis classification point aggregation (診療区分別点数集計)
purpose.summary: ORCR0640 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system that aggregates and edits inpatient medical insurance claim (レセプト) data by diagnosis/treatment category. It processes indexed files (RECE62, RECE64) containing receipt records, computing point totals, co-payment amounts, and various insurance-related fields for submission to Japanese health insurers.

notable_features: 46 COPY statements indicating heavy use of copybooks
586 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
INDEXED file organization with DYNAMIC access
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP (decoded as latin-1), causing Japanese characters to appear as garbled latin-1 sequences in the truncated view. This is normal for ORCA system files. The program is clearly production-grade JMA ORCA receipt software. Truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify with high confidence.
